skill.name: seo-optimizer
skill.description: Audit WordPress SEO metadata for Yoast SEO or Rank Math, including focus keywords, meta descriptions, and featured images. The skill reports issues and guides reviewed fixes using WordPress data and Unsplash image searches.
skill.summary: Audit WordPress SEO fields and featured images, then produce prioritized fixes.
skill.author: CrazySwami

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real risk from external command execution, direct WordPress database access, a hardcoded default site URL, and a hidden Claude MCP configuration reference. Many Markdown fences, documentation links, and WordPress metadata references are false positives rather than shell execution or system reconnaissance. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: External command execution for Docker, MySQL, and curl
remediation.suggestion: Use Python database and HTTP libraries with strict URL validation, clear user confirmation, and no command wrappers.

remediation.issue: Hardcoded default WordPress URL and database credentials
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user configuration or environment variables, and avoid contacting any default external target.
Use WordPress REST APIs or SEO plugin APIs for updates, and require preview approval before modifying metadata.
Remove the /root/.claude/.mcp.json dependency and document explicit Unsplash setup without private config access.
Add user review for selected images, license checks, and explicit approval before uploading media to WordPress.

content.value_statement: WordPress teams need fast checks for SEO metadata, featured images, and keyword coverage. This skill audits Yoast or Rank Math pages and produces actionable recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Audits WordPress pages and optional custom post types through the REST API.
Reads Yoast SEO metadata from wp_postmeta through Docker MySQL commands.
Checks focus keyword presence, title usage, and meta description usage.
Scores meta description length against 120 to 160 character guidance.
Checks featured image IDs, titles, ALT text, and file paths.
Prints human-readable reports or machine-readable audit output from audit.py.
limitations: Requires a matching local Docker database container and WordPress schema.
Uses hardcoded default database credentials and site URL unless changed.
The provided script audits and reports; documented fixes need separate execution.
Unsplash and WordPress upload steps require valid API access and user review.

use_cases.title: Audit a WordPress Launch
use_cases.description: Check pages before release for missing focus keywords, weak descriptions, and incomplete featured image metadata.

use_cases.title: Prepare Content Updates
use_cases.description: Find pages that need improved meta descriptions or better keyword placement before a publishing cycle.

use_cases.title: Review Client SEO Health
use_cases.description: Generate a structured issue list for Yoast or Rank Math sites and prioritize fixes by page score.

prompt_templates.title: Audit All Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the SEO optimizer against my WordPress site and summarize missing focus keywords, meta descriptions, and featured images.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the about page only. Report its SEO score, missing fields, and the safest next changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Custom Posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit pages and property posts. Group recommendations by focus keyword, meta description, and featured image issues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Safe Remediation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the audit results, separate API-safe fixes from database-only fixes, and create a plan that requires approval before writes.

output: Home scores 85 because the focus keyword and description are present.
Portfolio scores 0 because the focus keyword, meta description, and featured image are missing.

output_examples.input: Check the about page for image SEO.
output_examples.output: The about page has a featured image, but the ALT text does not include the focus keyword. Update the ALT text before publication.

output_examples.input: Summarize fixes after a client audit.
output: Two pages have meta descriptions shorter than 120 characters.
One featured image needs a title that matches the focus keyword.

best_practices: Run the audit in a staging environment before checking production content.
Review every proposed metadata or media change before applying it.
Replace hardcoded URLs and credentials with project-specific configuration.
anti_patterns: Do not run database updates without a recent backup and explicit approval.
Do not accept Unsplash image choices without license and relevance review.
Do not use the default site URL for unrelated WordPress projects.

faq.question: Does this skill work with Yoast SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks Yoast focus keywords, meta descriptions, SEO titles, and featured image metadata.

faq.question: Does this skill work with Rank Math?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions document Rank Math metadata fields, although the script focuses on Yoast database keys.

faq.question: Can it update my WordPress site automatically?
faq.answer: The script mainly audits and reports. Any metadata or image update should require review and approval first.

faq.question: What access does it need?
faq.answer: It needs WordPress REST API access and local database access through the configured Docker MySQL container.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should I configure before use?
faq.answer: Set the correct site URL, database container, database credentials, and any approved image search integration.
